blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Я получаю настоящее удовольствие, ___ (помогать) нетрудоспособным людям.
exercises.prompt: I really enjoy helping disabled people.
exercises.why: The main and the subordinate clauses have the same actor. The imperfective деепричастие indicates an action simultaneous with the action of the predicate whether the latter is in the present, past or future: *Переписывая домашнюю работу, он делает (делал, будет делать, сделал, сделает) новые ошибки. Imperfective деепричастия are formed by substituting the ending of the 3rd person plural of the present tense (-ют, -ут, -ят, -ат) with -я, or -а after ж, ч, ш, щ: читают — читая; идут — идя; говорят — говоря; служат — служа. The stress in most coincides with that of the first person singular. b) From the derivatives of -ставать, -знавать and -давать they are formed from the infinitives:… — DLI, Lessons 100 and 102.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The main and the subordinate clauses have the same actor. (DLI, Lessons 100 and 102)
